research_question: Can discovery retain predictive utility while adding target-related information beyond a context-only anchor for each identifiable perturbation input?

model_contract.residual_initialization: exactly zero so checkpoint zero reproduces the anchor
model_contract.increment_scale_selection: among development-eligible Fold-3 states, maximize Global PCC then minimize MSE
model_contract.residual_constraint: every residual output is multiplicatively gated by centered chemical or dose features and has no output bias

development_diagnostics.chemical: target-related loss increase under target-blind matched chemical replacement
development_diagnostics.dose: target-related loss increase under a separated within-chemical observed-dose replacement when identifiable
development_diagnostics.residual: correlation between the learned increment and response remaining after the frozen context anchor
development_diagnostics.map_variation_reference: candidate-local pairwise variation across independently frozen sham maps

qualification.checkpoint_disposition: one map-calibrated disposition per independently fitted trajectory endpoint
qualification.cohort_aggregation: continuous effects and Q/U/I/N counts across ten trajectory endpoints; no cross-endpoint vote
qualification.unidentifiable_input_policy: do not force behavioral dependence, do not claim support, and do not use the input to reject an otherwise qualified endpoint

stopping_rule: Freeze the registered endpoints before endpoint-held-out audit and open Fold 5 only after the audit protocol is fixed.
